description: Source file implementing internal string formatting functions for the Abseil library, including argument binding, format processing, and output formatting.

classes.name: ArgContext
classes.description: Helper class for binding format arguments to conversions.

classes.name: DefaultConverter
classes.description: Default implementation of a format converter that writes to a sink.

classes.name: SummarizingConverter
classes.description: Converter that summarizes formatted arguments into a string.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds an unbound conversion to a format argument using a provided argument pack.

methods.name: BindFromPosition
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a format argument at a specified position.

methods.name: ConvertAll
methods.description: Converts all parts of a format specification using a specified converter.
